reason: The kernel's logistic-tail decomposition of SiLU was exhaustively verified over its entire legal input domain: a runtime probe (t7) ran run(x) on all 63,488 finite FP16 values (including signed zeros, subnormals, and both extrema ±65504) and compared against FP64 real-arithmetic SiLU, finding zero breaches of the 1e-6 absolute tolerance. The worst case, 9.49e-7 at x=16.671875, occurs exactly in the mid-range region the only claim (c1) predicted would breach, and it still satisfies the contract's fixed absolute bound. The contract explicitly permits algebraic rewrites and base-2 exponentials provided the 1e-6 absolute tolerance holds across the whole domain, which the exhaustive evidence confirms. No open claims remain, all open claims had evidence, and the Skeptic reviewed the latest evidence and recorded no new claims (t9). No in-scope correctness failure exists.
